findings.reason: two implementable sections specify opposite outcomes for the same ended-coordinator state, so whichever node lands second breaks the other's done-when, and the plan must state the ordering or which rule governs.
findings.text: §17 says a whole-plan dispatch by any session queues a plan whose coordinating session has ended and then coordinates it, while §9 (implementable) accepts a plan the resolution gives no live coordinator only when the plan's sprint is one the session already coordinates a plan in; after §17 lands an ended coordinator is "no live coordinator", so §17's first case and §9's second case cannot both hold
